display.name: Red packets
display.summary: Send and claim legacy red packets through Phinix inventory. Before updating this plugin, update the Phinix Rework main mod on Steam to version 0.10.1 or later. Wait for the download to finish, then restart the game.
display.changelog: 1.2.0: Redesigned packet pages, grouped item selection, improved claim-result checks and large-list handling.
